admission: A fix is backported now, as an admitted patch with its own failing-without-the-fix tests and a gate record, only when it is reachable in the configuration claude-multi renders and it protects stored credentials or the availability of sign-in or API-key routes. Everything else is carried by the rebase onto the 8.x line or needs no action.
rendered_configuration: listener on 127.0.0.1 only, every client authenticated by the gateway API key
plugins.enabled false, Home off, discovery off, pprof off
logging-to-file false and no request-log key (request logging off; error logs of failed requests are still forced)
disable-cooling true for every credential, no request-scoped error rules, no per-credential or per-provider cooling override
management only through the environment key and the read-only allowlist on the Nix channel, otherwise off
request-retry 0, max-retry-credentials 1, fill-first routing; one auto-refresh loop per process with 16 workers

dependencies.go_mod: only the module path changes (/v7 to /v8); the go directive stays 1.26.0
dependencies.go_sum: byte-identical between the pinned and the reviewed release

vulncheck.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 on the final four target builds with govulncheck v1.8.0 and https://vuln.go.dev: seven reviewed dispositions per target, no unreviewed findings. Source-mode traces still reach affected Git and SSH operations only through the managed-excluded Git token store; OpenPGP remains absent and its unfixed disposition is retained. Binary hashes and trace bindings are in gateway/vulnerability-dispositions.json.
vulncheck.run: tools/_build/vulncheck.py verifies each shipped gateway against gateway/vulnerability-dispositions.json; source-mode govulncheck -show traces ./cmd/server rechecks reachability for all four target GOOS/GOARCH pairs

fixes.subject: fix(logging): prevent request log collisions and select latest log by ID
fixes.reason: Reachable for the forced error logs of failed requests, but it concerns two log files with one name, not stored credentials or route availability; the read-only management allowlist refuses log retrieval.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): isolate credential-scoped quota cooldown from model quota state
fixes.reason: Not reachable: every change sits behind cooling being enabled, and the rendered disable-cooling true applies to every credential (no request-scoped force-cooldown rule, no cooling override). Upstream's regression tests fail on the pinned tree with cooling enabled; the same model-only plus credential-scoped 429 sequence under the rendered setting leaves no credential or model deadline.

fixes.subject: feat(pluginhost): add host http operation bridge and lifecycle scoping
fixes.reason: Not reachable: plugins are disabled, so no plugin stream, callback or instance exists.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve file priority across plugin auth refreshes
fixes.reason: Not reachable: the refresh path it fixes runs only through plugin auth adapters (plugins are disabled); its management hunk is refused by the read-only allowlist.

fixes.subject: fix(api): immediately close connections on stop and guard state access
fixes.reason: Partial backport, re-reviewed 2026-10-07: only Service.Run creates the existing 30-second shutdown context inside its defer, so its budget starts on exit. The same local patch independently joins in-flight refresh workers through durable save and receipt reporting; atomic replacement alone prevents torn files, not loss of a rotated token. The listener-locking and immediate HTTP connection-closing changes remain deferred to rebase; HTTP graceful draining is unchanged. A live v7* tag check found v7.3.20 (ef9e71201e0ca72b03a540d9b6e0862f8c053347) latest, and its 43-commit comparison from v7.3.15 contains no smaller worker-join fix. This bounded wait does not guarantee persistence after a crash, SIGKILL, filesystem failure or a stop-budget overrun.

fixes.subject: fix(session): avoid rescanning large payloads during session extraction
fixes.reason: CPU hardening for large request bodies; requests come only from local clients holding the gateway API key, and no credential or route state is involved.

fixes.subject: fix(interceptors): avoid cloning request body for read-only interceptors
fixes.reason: Resource change with shared-buffer semantics that overlap the keyed-safety and interceptor patches; it needs an ownership audit, not a security backport.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve attributes and path across plugin refreshes
fixes.reason: The plugin refresh part is not reachable (plugins are disabled). The watcher retry matters only when a credential path is missing for more than the 50 ms replace check; every credential writer here (sign-in and refresh saves) replaces the file by an atomic rename, so the path never disappears.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): unschedule disabled invalid_grant credentials and apply exponential backoff for enabled invalid_grant
fixes.reason: The disabled-credential part is not reachable: a credential is disabled only by a disabled field in its file or by a management write, claude-multi writes neither and the allowlist refuses management writes. For an enabled credential it changes only how often a refresh that already failed with invalid_grant is retried (every 5 minutes on the pinned release, 1 minute doubling to 30 minutes upstream); it restores no route and protects no stored credential.

fixes.subject: feat(auth): support terminal rejection in plugin scheduler
fixes.reason: New plugin scheduler contract; plugins are disabled.

fixes.subject: feat(tui): support remote management base URL for client mode
fixes.reason: A feature that widens where management credentials may be sent, not a fix.

fixes.subject: feat(config): add v8 configuration API; feat(api): use query params for v8 oauth routes
fixes.reason: New /v8/management namespace and OAuth routes; the read-only management allowlist scopes only /v0/management and must be extended to the new namespace before these routes are enabled.

fixes.subject: configuration migration to the v8 format
fixes.reason: Migration behaviour absent from the pinned release; the rebase must prove that local security settings are neither lost nor re-enabled by the migration.

fixes.subject: fix(pluginhost): preserve disabled state in host auth callbacks
fixes.reason: Not reachable: the host auth callbacks serve plugins only, and plugins are disabled.

fixes.subject: fix(discovery): support bonded interfaces and deduplicate build warnings
fixes.reason: LAN discovery is disabled in the rendered configuration, and the change widens advertisement rather than fixing a flaw.

fixes.subject: feat(codex): extract and persist subscription plan type
fixes.reason: Its Auth.Clone empty-map fix is already covered by the local snapshot patch, which also deep-copies metadata containers; the plan metadata is a feature.

fixes.subject: feat(sdk): add Home credential capabilities and quota APIs
fixes.reason: New Home and plugin-host SDK surface; Home is off.

fixes.subject: feat(logging): switch request ID generation to UUIDv7
fixes.reason: Request identifiers are not authorization tokens.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): log warnings on auth persistence failures
fixes.reason: Persistence failures are already reported by the local metadata-only save receipts; upstream's warnings carry credential ids and raw error text.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): track auto-refresh job epochs and bound credential acquisition
fixes.reason: The bounded acquisition is Antigravity-only, and claude-multi has no Antigravity provider, route or sign-in. The job-epoch part needs refresh jobs that outlive the 1-minute pending window again and again, fill a queue of at least 64 jobs, or a restarted loop: Claude and ChatGPT account refreshes are bounded (30 s per attempt, 3 attempts), the loop starts once per process, and an install holds a handful of sign-ins.

fixes.subject: fix(home): defer plugin load marking and preempt failing config on retry
fixes.reason: Home lifecycle only; Home is off.

fixes.subject: feat(api): support request path overrides and image protocols in model execution
fixes.reason: A new outbound-routing surface, not a fix; the rebase needs destination, path and redirect coverage for it.

fixes.subject: fix(management): remove deprecated credential quota endpoints from v8 API
fixes.reason: The removed endpoints do not exist in the pinned release.

fixes.subject: feat(oauth): support per-channel model settings overrides
fixes.reason: Configuration feature that overlaps the local OAuth model overlay.

fixes.subject: fix(claude): fail open on unmapped oauth mcp tool aliases
fixes.reason: Forwards an unmapped tool name; it does not bypass authentication.

fixes.subject: fix(executor): support negotiated ALPN protocols in uTLS client
fixes.reason: Compatibility for endpoints that negotiate HTTP/1.1; the pinned client forces HTTP/2, which current sign-in and refresh endpoints accept; no verification bypass is involved.

fixes.subject: fix(codex): handle upstream stream disconnect before first payload as bad gateway
fixes.reason: Per-request error classification and failover; with one credential tried per request it changes the reported error, not credential state.

fixes.subject: Meta subscription metadata, client header and cooldown compatibility
fixes.reason: Compatibility changes, not security fixes.

fixes.subject: Claude OAuth fingerprint, cloaking and thinking visibility
fixes.reason: Client-compatibility work that overlaps the local retention and compatibility patches; no gateway authorization fix.

fixes.subject: thought-signature replay, Session_id support and stream log volume
fixes.reason: Model-protocol handling and log volume, not gateway authentication.

fixes.subject: fix(registry): keep request context active until response body is read
fixes.reason: Updater catalog fetch; no credential or SSRF change.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve resolved model capabilities and configuration update support
fixes.reason: Broad compatibility work, not a security-only change.

fixes.subject: fix(xai): bump pinned grok client version to 1.0.44 for chat-proxy
fixes.reason: Client identity compatibility, not a dependency or security fix.

fixes.subject: feat(config): introduce client configuration section for codex settings
fixes.reason: Configuration restructuring.

fixes.subject: signature log aggregation and executor translation refactors
fixes.reason: No authentication, credential or verification change.
